svg.title: Rekognition detect labels
svg.desc: A React site on CloudFront uploads an image straight to S3. An ObjectCreated notification invokes a Lambda function that calls Rekognition DetectLabels and publishes the result to an AppSync Events channel that the browser is subscribed to.
